quarterly_data.signal: Capacity, utilisation, pricing and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): semiconductor (WLP etc., bumping, 24h/day basis) H1 2026 capacity 493,300 wafers vs 1,062,000 for full-year 2025; production 421,452 wafers; average UTILISATION 85.4% (electronic materials 47.6%, lead tabs 36.9%). Average WLP price (bumping revenue / wafers sold) KRW 175,660 per wafer in H1 2026 vs KRW 157,636 in 2025 and KRW 156,317 in 2024. Consolidated H1 PP&E additions KRW 57,374,903,684 vs KRW 24,687,979,993 in H1 2025 (parent KRW 27,188,698,817); open machinery purchase commitment KRW 10,107,000 thousand; construction-in-progress transferred to PP&E KRW 6,273,044 thousand. Semiconductor raw-material purchases KRW 59,953M in H1 (targets KRW 9,946M, plating solution KRW 14,142M), with target prices at KRW 7,353,076 vs KRW 5,693,923 in 2025. Orders are placed roughly monthly, so no order backlog is reported.

quarterly_data.signal: R&D and technology roadmap (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): H1 2026 R&D spend KRW 13,000M (4.52% of revenue). Ongoing programmes include a chiplet heterogeneous-integration high-performance AI semiconductor package (embedded Si bridge RDL interposer, since 2023-04), a 2.5D SiP integrating a processor with high-speed stacked memory (PIM), a petaflops-class compute plus GB-class DRAM PIM platform (since 2025-04), nPoP chip-last, FOWLP antenna-in-package and a domestic backside-protection EMC film for system semiconductors. The electronic-materials business supplies developer, etchant, photoresist and cleaner chemicals and focuses on materials used in the HBM process. Nepes holds 10% of Deca Technologies Inc. (equity-method associate, H1 revenue KRW 7,702,866 thousand).
